_why: THE RUN-AXES CONTRACT, AS BEHAVIOUR RATHER THAN AS SOURCE (#616).
check-run-axes-parity holds the two PYTHON planes byte-identical, which is the right
test for two copies of one Python source and is not expressible against a TypeScript
port. So the node plane was outside it, and what stood in for the comparison was a set
of literals in runAxes.test.ts described as 'taken from the Python'. That is a second
spelling with nothing asserting it still matches the first: the literals cannot notice
THIS FIXTURE FOUND A REAL DISAGREEMENT ON ITS FIRST RUN. For a session-only run the
Python planes emitted `langfuse_tags: []` and node omitted the key, because Python
tested emptiness BEFORE removing the session and node tested it after. Python's own
early return states the intent -- nothing to say, say nothing -- so the Python planes
were contradicting their own contract in the one branch nothing exercised.
EVERY CASE IS PLANE-INDEPENDENT ON PURPOSE. The axis VALUES here are literals both
runtimes can set (`runtime: probe`, not `runtime: node`), so the same expectation holds
on all three planes and a case cannot quietly become a per-plane assertion.
_mustContainWhy: Named ids rather than a count. `cases.length > N` passes after someone deletes the one
case that found the bug and adds two easy ones, and runAxes.test.ts had no session-only
case at all -- which is exactly the corner the hand-copied literals left uncovered.
Each consumer asserts these ids are PRESENT as well as asserting every case passes:
equality alone is satisfied by two empty sets, so the pair is what carries it.

cases.why: THE CASE THAT FOUND THE DIVERGENCE. A session is an identity, not an axis, so with nothing else set there are no tags to report -- and the key is absent rather than present-and-empty.
Nothing to say, say nothing. The empty object, not an object with empty members.
A single axis becomes one `axis:value` tag.
Tags are sorted by axis name, so two planes emitting the same axes emit the same list in the same order.
Both keys, with the session pulled out of the tags rather than appearing as one.
An absent axis and an axis whose value is the empty string are different facts, and only one of them is true. The empty one is dropped rather than recorded.
